description: Notification plans after a clock rollback (RFC 0003 §10.3): exact excluded occurrences, request capacity and coverage.

vectors.description: Asr was handled and is explicitly excluded after a clock rollback to 15:15. The allowance of one selects Maghrib, not Asr; coverage ends at Isha.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §10.3 (#18): exclude every exact occurrence supplied by the caller.

vectors.description: Only Asr is enabled and it is excluded. Even with no request allowance, the whole effective range is complete: no pending alert remains to omit.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §10.3 (#18): exclude every exact occurrence supplied by the caller.

vectors.description: The planning instant is exactly Asr's fire date. An explicit excluded occurrence isn't selected, even though an alert at now is otherwise in the effective range.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §10.3 (#18): exclude every exact occurrence supplied by the caller.

vectors.description: Asr was reported a second early, delivered at 15:35, and the clock returned to 15:34:59.500. The caller's prior-report snapshot excludes this occurrence even though the planning instant is after the report time; the planner doesn't compare it.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §10.3 (#18): exclude every exact occurrence supplied by the caller.

vectors.description: The caller excludes Asr at 15:35, but Asr is recalculated to 15:40. The same logical identity at the new fire date remains selectable.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §10.3 (#18): exclude every exact occurrence supplied by the caller.

vectors.description: An excluded Asr with the same owning day, kind and fire date in another namespace doesn't exclude this schedule's Asr.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §10.3 (#18): exclude every exact occurrence supplied by the caller.

vectors.description: Asr's before-reminder is excluded, its at-time alert isn't. A budget of one selects the at-time alert with complete coverage of both kinds to 21:00.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §10.3 (#18): exclude every exact occurrence supplied by the caller.

vectors.description: Asr is now missing from the source. Its excluded old occurrence resolves no source gap: an unknown changed fire date could still be ahead, so coverage ends at now.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §10.3 (#18): exclude every exact occurrence supplied by the caller.

vectors.description: With no near-term window, Asr is excluded before the at-time fill spends its allowance of one on Maghrib; Isha ends the coverage.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §10.3 (#18): exclude every exact occurrence supplied by the caller.
